title: US monthly equity expiration (October 2027) — the last session before the FOMC communications blackout opens
source: OCC: The Options Clearing Corporation's own 2027 Options Expiration Calendar, re-fetched and re-decoded independently this session (2026-09-06) at www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar (HTTP 200, 34,855 bytes) -- the Options Industry Council site whose every page footer reads '(c)2026 The Options Clearing Corporation. All rights reserved.' Its legend maps GUID 6937B1D1-F5D5-46CD-BBE7-041C7BE7B85B to 'Monthly equity, index, and cash-settled currency options expiration date and PM settled index options cease trading', and the data array carries exactly that type on 2027-10-15. The adjacent rows read the same way they do in every other month: 2027-10-14 carries 15AA2B9D ('Monthly A.M. settled index options cease trading'), 2027-10-20 carries EEF1643B ('Monthly Volatility Products Expiration date'), and 2027-10-11 is marked 'Bank holiday'. VALIDATED AGAINST THIS REPO'S OWN ROWS BEFORE BEING TRUSTED, 12 OF 12: the same API returns 2026's monthly equity expirations as 01-16, 02-20, 03-20, 04-17, 05-15, 06-18, 07-17, 08-21, 09-18, 10-16, 11-20, 12-18 -- every one its month's third Friday except the Juneteenth-displaced Thursday 2026-06-18, and all five dates this calendar already holds as confirmed (opex-2026-08-21, -09-18, -10-16, -11-20, -12-18) match exactly. INDEPENDENTLY CORROBORATED BY THE STANDING RULE: October 2027's third Friday is 2027-10-15 (October 1 2027 is a Friday, so the Fridays are the 1st, 8th, 15th, 22nd and 29th), and NYSE's own 2027 holiday column lists no October closure. PROMOTED estimate -> confirmed here on market-events-data.ts's own OCC: prefix; the no-self-confirm convention binds the DISCOVERING sweep (fomc-blackout-start-2027-10-16, 2026-09-06) and this is the independent second look, the same precedent opex-2027-09-17 and fhfa-hpi-2027-02-23 record. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-06), shadowing the single proposal that filed it (proposals/opex-2027-10-15.from-fomc-blackout-start-2027-10-16.json, read in full first). IMPACT medium follows the class: this calendar's confirmed 2026 rows file monthlies (08-21, 10-16, 11-20) medium and quarterlies (09-18, 12-18) high, and October 2027 is a monthly, not a triple witching. WHAT THE LEDGER MEASURED, AND WHAT IT REFUSES: 2027-10-15 is the last session on which an FOMC participant may speak before the communications blackout opens 12:00 a.m. ET Saturday 2027-10-16 (the window derivation re-derived here independently, reproducing all eight 2027 and all eight 2026 windows this repo already holds, 16 of 16). THE GATE ADDS NOTHING TO THE EXPIRATION: across 158 monthly expirations 2007-2026, the 58 that are blackout deadlines run a VIX change of -0.383 against -0.384 for the other 100 (permutation P = 0.998; era-ranked P = 0.913; the following five sessions' realized vol P = 0.930). AND THE INHERITED 'POST-EXPIRATION VOL DROP' IS ABOUT HALF A FRIDAY EFFECT: VIX falls on Fridays generally (-0.151 vs +0.038, P = 0.007), and against a Friday control the expiration-specific residual is -0.336 vs -0.095, P = 0.088 -- unproven, not established. ONE LIVE CANDIDATE, REGISTERED RATHER THAN BANKED: deadline monthlies carry a larger era-ranked absolute S&P move (0.586 vs 0.467, P = 0.006-0.014 across four era bands; raw P = 0.037 once 2008-2011 is dropped; P = 0.026 holding the month fixed) with the VIX channel flat and no mechanism, one of roughly nineteen unadjusted comparisons. Same channel caveat as every entry here: symbols is empty and no house playbook is opex-keyed (re-grepped this session, zero real hits). Confirmed changes what we KNOW, never what we DO.
